messages:
henry: Urgent hotfix for GPU OOMs observed in eu-west when multimodal requests trigger long KV-chains. Patch ready: `redwood/serving:2.8.2-quantfix` (quant kernel tweak + tokenizer guard). No client/schema changes. Requesting expedited 00:10-00:40 UTC slot. Plan: smoke synthetic prompt -> 5% canary -> 100% ramp in 10m if green. Auto-rollback: 5xx > 0.4% over 2m OR gpu_mem_pct > 85% for 3m. Will pin dedicated pools until post-verification.

deploy-bot: Deploy request created by @henry
- image: `redwood/serving:2.8.2-quantfix`
- targets: eu-west1,dedicated-pool-2
- strategy: staged canary (5% -> 100%)
- smoke job: `smoke/synthetic-multimodal-kv` (1k token + image)
- rollback-probe: `5xx>0.4||gpu_mem>85%`

lina: fast question: does this change the quant path for other regions or only eu-west?

henry: quant kernel change is gated; globally available but we only roll to eu-west multi-tenant. Dedicated pools remain pinned to 2.8.1.

marcus: I'll be release owner for the window and can execute pin/unpin. @kevin ops please ack so we can avoid escalation.

ops-bot: Paging oncall: @kevin (medium)  acknowledge within 5m to avoid auto-escalation.

kevin: acked. I'll monitor GPU memory, per-model token distribution, and trace error patterns.

lina: I can +1 expedited if rollback is automatic and runbook link is provided. Also request a short release-note blurb.

henry: added runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/quant-kernel-gpumem. Release note: "2.8.2-quantfix: address GPU OOMs from long KV chains by tuning quant kernels and tokenizer bounds. No client changes." Adding pin command to PR.

marcus: putting scheduled window: start 3612345700 -> smoke then canary 5%. CLI preview below.

```
/deploy --image redwood/serving:2.8.2-quantfix \
  --targets eu-west1,dedicated-pool-2 \
  --strategy canary --canary-percent 5 --canary-duration 10m \
  --smoke smoke/synthetic-multimodal-kv --rollback-probe "5xx>0.4||gpu_mem>85%" \
  --pin-dedicated "redwood/serving:2.8.1"
```

henry: starting smoke now, results in ~90s.

(90s later)
henry: smoke passed: synthetic prompt completed, kv cache behavior normal, gpu mem baseline stable. Kicking 5% canary.

deploy-bot: Canary deployed to 5% at 3612345745. Observability hooks active (GPU dashboards, token histograms, error filters).

kevin: monitoring GPU mem and error streams. no signs of regression after 6m.

lina: approve ramp to 100% if green after full canary duration.

(10m later)
marcus: ramping to 100% now per expedited consent. Keeping dedicated pools pinned.

deploy-bot: Ramp to 100% completed at 3612345855.

kevin: post-ramp checks: 5xx at baseline, gpu_mem healthy, no new OOM stack traces. I'll keep a 30m watch.

marcus: thanks all for quick approvals. I'll unpin dedicated pools after 30m if no regressions and add final post-deploy summary to the release PR.

henry: post-deploy note drafted: "Hotfix 2.8.2 deployed to eu-west to mitigate GPU OOMs under long multimodal KV chains. Dedicated pools pinned during canary. Monitoring active; no rollback required." Tagging support and including runbook link. :rocket:
